summary: MetroCity Bankshares, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce a quarterly cash dividend of $0.29 per share on its common stock. The dividend is payable August 7, 2026, to shareholders of record as of July 29, 2026. The registrant is the issuer making a routine dividend declaration. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, special capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change is indicated. The filing is a routine current report concerning a regular quarterly dividend, which does not constitute a special situation. No deal terms apply.
